turns.Question: Run autofocus. On the current sample, focus search is in a state where it does not converge normally.
turns.Ans:
The attempt to run autofocus failed because there is a communication error with the microscope camera (TUCam). Both starting the camera stream and executing the autofocus procedure returned a system error (`-2147483132`). 

Since the autofocus tool relies on real-time image analysis of the laser spot, it cannot proceed while the camera is unresponsive. Please check the camera connection or restart the camera software.
